scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Refrigerated Vehicles – Haryana
description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana is a significant initiative launched by the Government of India to enhance the fisheries sector in the country. 

This scheme was officially launched on September 10, 2020. 

It aims to bring about a blue revolution by promoting sustainable and responsible fishing practices. 

The scheme is designed to increase fish production and productivity in India. 

The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana has a total outlay of INR 20,050 crores. 

This financial allocation is intended to be utilized over a period of five years. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to double the income of fishers and fish farmers. 

The government aims to increase fish production to 22 million metric tons by the year 2024-2025. 

The scheme also focuses on creating an additional employment opportunity for 55 lakh people in the fisheries sector. 

One of the critical components of this scheme is the provision for refrigerated vehicles. 

These vehicles are essential for the transportation of fish and fish products. 

They help in maintaining the quality and freshness of the fish during transit. 

In Haryana, the refrigerated vehicle initiative under this scheme aims to support local fishers. 

The government provides financial assistance for the purchase of these refrigerated vehicles. 

The assistance is aimed at promoting better supply chain management in the fisheries sector. 

The scheme encourages the establishment of a robust infrastructure for fish marketing. 

Eligible beneficiaries can receive up to 40% of the total cost of the refrigerated vehicle as a subsidy. 

For SC/ST and women beneficiaries, the subsidy can go up to 60%. 

The maximum subsidy amount provided for refrigerated vehicles is capped at INR 10 lakh. 

This financial assistance is a significant boost for small and marginal fishers. 

It enables them to invest in modern transportation facilities. 

The eligibility criteria for availing of the benefits under this scheme include being a registered fisher or fish farmer. 

Applicants must also be involved in the fish production or fish marketing business. 

The age limit for applicants is generally set at 18 years and above. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required to apply for this scheme. 

However, applicants must provide proof of their involvement in the fisheries sector. 

The application process for the refrigerated vehicles under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana is straightforward. 

Interested beneficiaries must submit their applications to the respective state fisheries department. 

The application form can be obtained from the official website of the Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying. 

Applicants need to provide documents such as identity proof, address proof, and bank details. 

They must also submit proof of their registration as fishers or fish farmers. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be verified by the concerned authorities. 

After verification, eligible applicants will receive the subsidy amount directly into their bank accounts. 

The disbursement of funds typically occurs within 30 to 60 days of application approval. 

The refrigerated vehicles are expected to be procured within a stipulated time frame after receiving the subsidy. 

The implementation of this scheme is overseen by the Department of Fisheries in Haryana. 

The department is responsible for monitoring the progress and ensuring that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries. 

The contact details for the Haryana Fisheries Department can be found on their official website. 

The scheme also aims to enhance the overall infrastructure for fish marketing in the state. 

This includes the establishment of fish landing centers and cold storage facilities. 

The refrigerated vehicles will significantly reduce post-harvest losses. 

Currently, post-harvest losses in the fisheries sector can be as high as 20 to 30%. 

By improving transportation, the scheme aims to minimize these losses. 

The initiative is expected to boost the income of fishers by improving market access. 

With better transportation facilities, fishers can reach larger markets. 

This will allow them to sell their products at competitive prices. 

The scheme aligns with the government's vision of "Atmanirbhar Bharat" or self-reliant India. 

It promotes self-sufficiency in the fisheries sector. 

The refrigerated vehicle initiative is a part of a broader strategy to enhance the fisheries value chain. 

The government is also focusing on skill development and capacity building in the fisheries sector. 

Training programs are being conducted to educate fishers about modern fishing practices. 

The scheme is expected to contribute to the overall economic development of coastal and inland fishing communities. 

By 2025, the government aims to achieve a fish production target of 22 million metric tons. 

This will require substantial investment in infrastructure and technology. 

The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana is a critical step in this direction. 

The scheme is designed to be inclusive and benefit marginalized communities. 

Special provisions are made for women and SC/ST communities. 

The government is committed to ensuring that the benefits of this scheme reach all sections of society. 

The refrigerated vehicles will play a crucial role in achieving these objectives. 

As of now, the scheme has already started showing positive results in various states. 

Fish production has seen an increase due to better infrastructure and support systems. 

The initiative is also expected to enhance the nutritional security of the population. 

Fish is a vital source of protein for many households in India. 

The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana is a comprehensive approach to developing the fisheries sector. 

It addresses multiple challenges faced by fishers and fish farmers. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to improving livelihoods in rural areas. 

Overall, the refrigerated vehicles under this scheme are a significant step towards modernizing the fisheries sector in Haryana. 

The initiative aims to create a sustainable and profitable fishing industry in the state. 

By providing financial assistance for refrigerated vehicles, the government is empowering fishers to enhance their operations. 

This will ultimately lead to increased fish production and better market access. 

The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana is a landmark initiative with far-reaching implications for the fisheries sector in India.
